messages:
elaine: Noticed yesterday's scheduled playbook targeted a renewal cohort by mistake (vendor tag collision). ~4.9k touches. Can we add an approval gate for playbooks that touch >1k or include renewals?

omar: Agreed. Immediate: pause the scheduled job and upload a suppression list for the cohort. I'll pause from Admin now.

ops-bot: playbook-runner: run id scheduled-20260325-09 started 2026-03-25T03:10:01Z. recipients: 4896, phase: sending.

kevin: Paused. recipients_sent: 2,184. Suppression CSV path: s3://cs-ops/suppress/4901234567-suppress.csv. Also toggled worker drain to stop retries.

tara: Proposal for config changes: a) default new playbooks to dry_run=true; b) require manager approval when recipients>1000 OR renewals_pct>0.5%; c) add a UI approval flow with reasons and timestamped sign-off.

elaine: Also ask: exempt manual owner claims and accounts with health_score>0.7 from suppression. Add a fast path to route high-risk renewals to AE handoff instead of mass nudges.

omar: I'll run a dry-run owner-claim on 300 accounts first: `python cs_tools/claim_owners.py --cohort import-20260324 --limit 300 --dry-run`. Will post results.

kevin: Can we also add a preflight check that simulates the run and returns counts by segment (renewal, trial, enterprise) before allowing send? That would have caught this.

tara: Yes. Implementation notes: preflight = simulate_run(cohort) -> {counts} and if any threshold is breached show approval modal. I'll open a PR to add preflight to playbook runner and add the approval modal in Admin UI.

elaine: Great. Immediate comms: send apology only to trials that received the message and open a ticket routing for renewals. Draft copy suggestion in thread.

ops-bot: playbook-runner: scheduled-20260325-09 paused by kevin at 2026-03-25T03:18:10Z. recipients_sent: 2,184.

omar: Dry-run results (summary): 300 sampled -> 122 exact owner matches, 58 fuzzy matches, 12 renewals <60d. Will auto-claim exacts only.

kevin: Cool. I'll PR the playbook template change and add `cohort_threshold` default=1000 + `require_approval=true` for imports. ETA for PR review: today EOD.

tara: I'll schedule a 20-min sync with Product + Integrations to require a presubmit check on vendor imports. Also updating the runbook with incident steps.

elaine: Thanks everyone 44D. Follow-up tasks: 1) suppression uploaded (kevin) 2) dry-run owner-claim (omar) 3) apology copy (elaine) 4) PRs for preflight + approval (tara/kevin). We'll confirm in the sync.
